depiction.primary_object: square tray or inbox with semicircular thumb notch
modifiers: downward pointing arrow above the notch
depiction.composition: single container with centered downward arrow inside

readings.meaning: inbox / process incoming messages, mail, or tasks

ambiguity: Easily confused at a glance with the download bracket (arrow entering an open-top rectangle) or the archive box (3D box with a downward arrow on the front), and can be used loosely for downloading or archiving when those icons aren't seen alongside it.

modifier_semantics.meaning: incoming, receiving, downloading, or placing into

task_intents: clear out email or task inbox
download files or statements for offline use
collect incoming physical mail and paperwork

reasoning: Shows an inbox tray with a downward arrow pointing into it, universally understood as incoming mail/items (inbox), downloading, or archiving into a tray. It fits real tasks around inbox zero, triaging incoming requests, and downloading files, though it can be confused with a plain inbox tray or generic download arrow.

readings.meaning: move to inbox / incoming messages or items
download / save to local storage or folder
archive / file away into a box or drawer

pass1.ambiguity: Can be read interchangeably as 'inbox' (receiving messages/tasks), 'download' (saving files from the internet), or 'archive' (filing things into a box), and closely resembles a plain inbox tray without the arrow.

distinguishing: Unlike the open-top download bracket or the 3D archive box, this icon has a horizontal divider with a curved thumb notch near the bottom, marking it specifically as an inbox tray receiving incoming mail or tasks.
